product.name: Argus ROM Toolkit
product.purpose: Maintain a trustworthy, inspectable model of a user's ROM library and derived game information across supported desktop and Android platforms by indexing local libraries accurately and incrementally, identifying games, resolving metadata and artwork, and verifying local content against recognized hashes.

primary_users.role: Person managing a local ROM library
primary_users.technical_level: Comfortable selecting folders and reviewing library information without needing provider, runtime, or persistence internals
primary_users.work_context: Uses Argus on supported desktop or Android platforms to configure local library folders, inspect indexed content, resolve derived game information, monitor background jobs, and recover safely from interruption.

jobs_to_be_done.statement: Configure, scan, inspect, and remove local library folders without modifying the underlying user files.
Identify game content and resolve metadata and artwork through bounded, provider-independent workflows.
Verify local content against recognized hashes, including RetroAchievements-recognized content where supported.
Observe, cancel, retry, and recover durable background jobs while preserving authoritative state.
Use the same product capabilities through appropriate desktop and Android interactions without creating separate product architectures.

must_reduce: Uncertainty about library contents and game identity
Coupling between product orchestration and individual providers
must_not_become: A system that silently resumes abandoned significant work
experience_principles: Platform-adapted behavior instead of forced parity
